title: UnifiedVoiceCall - Data API
description: Represents a voice call that is captured or synced from a VoiceCall or Task record. This object is available for reports and dashboards in the Winter ’24 release and later.

ActivityDateTime.description: The date and time of the activity in the Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) time zone.

ActivitySubType.description: Provides standard subtypes to facilitate creating and searching for specific activity subtypes. Possible values are: Captured LegacyCall Streamed VoiceCall

ActivityType.description: The type of activity. Possible value is UnifiedVoiceCall.

CallDurationInSeconds.description: The duration of the voice call in seconds.

DetailId.description: The ID of the object that contains detailed activity-specific information. The object depends on the activity type. For example, the detail for a Task activity is a Task object. The detail for an Event activity is an Event object. This field is a relationship field.

IsInsightAvailable.description: Indicates whether the activity has an insight associated with it (true) or not (false). The default value is false.

Snippet.description: An abbreviation of the voice call content. This field has a maximum length of 255 characters.

Subject.description: Contains the subject of the voice call.
